actionAndCleanup.submission: Freeze exact key, settings and IOP1 image bytes. Changed work cannot reuse the key; uncertain action reconciles before replacement.
actionAndCleanup.completedRepeat: Refresh same unchanged completed job, no duplicate optimization
actionAndCleanup.cancel: Confirm CANCELED or authenticated owned NOT_FOUND before retiring local action; neither is a secure-erase receipt. Server retains a canceled tombstone/key until session expiry. Next deliberate batch uses a fresh action key.
actionAndCleanup.uncertainCancel: Recover same key/body then cancel known owned job, or explicitly revoke session; failed recovery does not unlock new work
actionAndCleanup.outputs: Infer type from frozen format/source; exact generated name and scoped path, bytes/sourceBytes/dimensions and aggregate32MiB; never follow arbitrary returned paths
actionAndCleanup.downloadValidation: Expected MIME, exact snapshot byte count, signature/header dimensions; no claim of full pixel decode or metadata proof
actionAndCleanup.localExport: Explicit matching new PNG/JPEG filename, locked local ancestors/stable volume path and owned temporary handle through no-replace rename/failure disposition; no existing-file overwrite
actionAndCleanup.lifecycle: Clear pairing input, invalidate generation, abort active transfer and request bounded best-effort session revoke. Unconfirmed cleanup remains unknown; exports already saved remain user files.
actionAndCleanup.lostSessionReceipt: No returned session capability means revoke cannot be confirmed; app expiry remains authoritative
actionAndCleanup.privacy: Transient local memory only; no file paths/names on wire, folder walk, arbitrary output path, logs/config/replication/saves/third-party upload
